title: Pinterest launches beauty guides feature and first-ever Beauty Trend Report with Sephora
summary: Pinterest’s new beauty guides feature will enhance pins with ‘how-to’ information and step-by-step instructions for doing hair, nail and make-up looks, helping users put beauty inspiration and ideas into practice at home or in salons

extraction.key_fact: 핀터레스트가 세포라와 함께 뷰티 가이드 기능 및 첫 뷰티 트렌드 리포트를 선보였다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Pinterest launches beauty guides feature and first-ever Beauty Trend Report with Sephora
